plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used (Cal-GETC pattern); the alternate maps in the page's dropdown are not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. HONEST DISCREPANCY: the map prints 'Total Units for Art/Studio Arts AA-T program: 61.5†' and a 4th-semester total of 13.0†, but the 4th-semester rows as printed (US History 3.0, Cal-GETC 5B 3.0†, Cal-GETC 5C Laboratory 1.0, UC/CSU Elective 3.0) sum to 10.0. This seed encodes the printed rows exactly (58.5 total); the dagger legend ('some classes may have higher units') is the map's own explanation for the gap. Nothing was added to force the published total. None of the courses on this map carry an official course prerequisite in their published descriptions (all listed as Advisories); prereq arrays are intentionally empty — see the official catalog's course descriptions. The Major Elective options are transcribed from the map's notes ('Please select one course: ART 124/ART 131*/ART 135/ART 136*/ART 140/ART 141*/ART 146*/ART 150/ART 170/ART 230*/ART 231*/ART 260/GDSN 178/PHTO 110/PHTO 130; *Requires a pre-requisite'). Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.

courses.title: Survey of Art from the Renaissance to Contemporary
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTH C1200 / ARTH C1200H per the official map's Cal-GETC 3A slot (marked M: also meets a major requirement). ARTH C1200 - Survey of Art from the Renaissance to Contemporary; ARTH C1200H - Survey of Art from the Renaissance to Contemporary Honors.

courses.title: Major Elective (Studio Art)
courses.choice_note: Major Elective per the official map's notes (first of three identical slots: 2nd, 3rd, 4th semesters). Official options: ART 124, ART 131, ART 135, ART 136, ART 140, ART 141, ART 146, ART 150, ART 170, ART 230, ART 231, ART 260, GDSN 178, PHTO 110, PHTO 130. The map marks ART 131, ART 136, ART 141, ART 146, ART 230, ART 231 with * (requires a prerequisite). See the major advising sheet / counselor.

courses.title: Survey of Mathematics
courses.choice_note: MATH 150 - Survey of Mathematics per the official map's Cal-GETC 2 row. The map's notes allow any of: DSCI 101, MATH 160, MATH 170, MATH 180, MATH 190/H, PSY 190, STAT C1000/H.

courses.title: Cal-GETC 1C - Oral Communication
courses.choice_note: Select one of COMM C1000 / COMM C1000H per the official map's Cal-GETC 1C (Oral Communication) row (codes only on the map).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 6 - Ethnic Studies
courses.choice_note: Select one of CHST 101 / EGSS 110 per the official map's Cal-GETC 6 (Ethnic Studies) row (codes only on the map).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 3B - Humanities
courses.choice_note: Choose one Humanities course from the official map's Cal-GETC 3B list.

courses.title: UC/CSU Elective
courses.choice_note: Select a course that transfers to UC; see a counselor.

courses.title: Major Elective (Art History)
courses.choice_note: Select one of ARTH C1100 / ARTH C1100H / ART 107 / ART 108 per the official map's Cal-GETC 3B slot (marked M: also meets a major requirement). ARTH C1100 - Survey of Art from Prehistory to the Medieval Era; ARTH C1100H - Survey of Western Art from Prehistory to the Medieval Era Honors; ART 107 - The Art of Asia; ART 108 - The Art of Mexico.

courses.title: Major Elective (Studio Art)
courses.choice_note: Major Elective per the official map's notes (second of three identical slots: 2nd, 3rd, 4th semesters); same option pool as the 2nd-semester slot.

courses.title: Cal-GETC 1B - Critical Thinking and Composition
courses.choice_note: Choose one course per the official map's Cal-GETC 1B (Critical Thinking and Composition) row: ENGL C1001, 1001H / PHIL 110, 110H (codes only on the map).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 4 - Social and Behavioral Sciences
courses.choice_note: Select one of POLS C1000 / POLS C1000H per the official map's Cal-GETC 4 row (codes only on the map).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 5A - Physical Science
courses.choice_note: Choose one Physical Science from the official map's Cal-GETC 5A list (labs marked * in the official list).

courses.title: US History (Cal-GETC 4)
courses.choice_note: Choose one U.S. History course per the official map (CSU American Institutions requirement): HIST C1001, C1001H, C1002, C1002H, 156, 157, 158, 159, 159H, 170.

courses.title: Cal-GETC 5B - Biological Science
courses.choice_note: Choose one Biological Science from the official map's Cal-GETC 5B list (labs marked * in the official list).

courses.title: Cal-GETC 5C - Laboratory
courses.choice_note: Choose one Laboratory course per the official map's Cal-GETC 5C list (take if a lab has not been completed in Cal-GETC 5A or 5B).

courses.title: UC/CSU Elective
courses.choice_note: Select a course that transfers to UC; see a counselor.
